milestone.title: mp autopilot session.json schema — durable per-session state for autopilot drives

intent.outcome: Every autopilot session has a single canonical, durable, versioned state file (session.json) that downstream milestones consume as source of truth for pane IDs, role config, queue state, and verifier verdicts.

problem.description: Today's mp watch keeps state in scattered files — `master-plan/.mp/watch.state.json` for the v2 control plane (M178), `master-plan/.mp/watch.log` for the structured log, and the milestone's own spec for execution. Recovering what happened to a session, especially after a crash or SIGINT (per M152), requires joining three files. The new mp autopilot design needs a single durable per-session record: pane IDs across orchestrator/runner/reviewer, role-config snapshots (so re-spawn reuses the same config), the milestone queue with per-milestone sub-state (cycle, stage, last notify), the topology in effect, and verifier verdicts. Reusing M178's control-plane shape gives a head start; this milestone adapts it to per-session folders and multi-milestone queues (with herdr workspace name `<project-name>-autopilot`).

in_scope: Define session.json schema: id, schema_version, herdr_workspace, topology, roles (per-role pane_id + model + harness + skill), config_overrides, queue (ordered milestone list with per-milestone stage/cycle/verifier_verdict/last_notify/evidence_refs), status, last_updated.
Validation: session.json validates against the project mini_schema (M188) with bounded read (32 MiB cap) and project-root containment.
Create-or-migrate scaffolding: when `mp autopilot start` runs against a plan with no autopilot/ dir, create the folder and write the schema-versioned session.json.
Document the schema in `docs/autopilot/session-format.md` so A2 (CLI rename), B (config+spawn), and C (verifier) can all reference it.
out_of_scope: The actual session lifecycle verbs (start/stop/pause/resume) — those land in B (config+spawn) and C (cycle governance).
Reading or surfacing session.json from raul — that's D1-D3.
Migration of legacy mp watch state into the new shape — covered by A2's legacy alias work.
Multi-session concurrency control — sessions are independent; this milestone is one session at a time.

acceptance_criteria.description: Autopilot session I/O validates against mini_schema, uses the shared bounded-read primitive with one explicit 32 MiB session limit, enforces project-root containment, and writes atomically.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_session_schema --no-fail-fast exit 0 (20/20 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: A sample session.json with the full schema (3-pane topology, 2 milestones in queue, role config snapshots, evidence_refs pointing at lifecycle / execution_status / spec_status / reviews.json verdict) round-trips through read+write without data loss.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_session_roundtrip --no-fail-fast exit 0 (7/7 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp autopilot session list` shows all sessions in the plan with id, status, last_updated; `mp autopilot session show <id>` renders the full session.json in canonical view.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_session_cli --no-fail-fast exit 0 (11/11 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: session.json includes runner_notes with typed kinds, body, cycle, and timestamp. `mp autopilot note` requires `--cycle` or derives it from the active queue item and rejects notes when neither is available.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_runner_notes --no-fail-fast exit 0 (13/13 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Per-milestone AC status is synchronized transactionally from the canonical milestone criterion state; session.json stores a projection plus source revision, and stale/conflicting `record-ac` writes are rejected rather than creating a second authority.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_ac_projection --no-fail-fast exit 0 (11/11 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Every role-state transition is performed through `mp autopilot session transition <session> --role <role> --state <state> [--working-on <value>]`; direct session-file edits are unnecessary. Valid transitions, actor metadata, timestamps, and invalid-transition rejection are tested.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_session_transitions --no-fail-fast exit 0 (12/12 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Each session has an append-only, sequence-numbered event log for dispatches, role transitions, reviews, decisions, controls, notes, and recovery. Writes use temp-file + fsync + atomic rename; interrupted writes recover the last valid revision without truncating prior events.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_session_recovery --no-fail-fast exit 0 (11/11 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: The documented session schema includes role state, working_on, prompt bundles, controls, last_state_change_at, event cursor/history, queue cycle history, terminal statuses, and version migration behavior consumed by M210-M217.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_session_full_contract --no-fail-fast exit 0 (15/15 pass)

design_decisions.choice: Per-session folder at `master-plan/autopilot/<id>/session.json` rather than a single global file.
design_decisions.rationale: Each session is a self-contained unit — easy to archive, diff, and recover. Concurrent writes serialize within one file; per-session folders unlock parallel-session writes (one per project checkout).

design_decisions.choice: Explicit `schema_version: integer` field; loaders reject unknown versions with a typed error. Bump on any breaking change.
design_decisions.rationale: The legacy mp watch state file (M152) already does this. Reusing the pattern means future migration paths compose cleanly.

design_decisions.choice: Queue is an ordered list; per-milestone sub-state is a typed object (not a sparse map).
design_decisions.rationale: Order matters for sequential execution (M179 ordered queue precedent); typed objects give the verifier a stable shape regardless of which milestone it's checking.

design_decisions.choice: Milestone criteria and review records remain canonical; session.json stores revisioned projections and append-only orchestration events, never independently editable duplicate truth.
design_decisions.rationale: The herdr runs repeatedly exposed evidence overwrite and cross-file drift. Revision checks and transactional projection prevent session telemetry from silently disagreeing with milestone state.

findings.description: After 'make clean' + cold rebuild, `cargo fmt --all -- --check` reports formatting drift in three files modified by M207 commits: `crates/mp/src/autopilot/list.rs` (import order at line 67), `crates/mp/tests/autopilot_session_roundtrip.rs` (multi-line use formatting at line 6), and `crates/mp/tests/autopilot_session_schema.rs` (lines 39, 92, 205, 228). The runner's self-review fix commit `652ffcf` claims `fmt, clippy clean, consumer-surface guard` but the current tree does not pass `make lint`'s `cargo fmt --check` step. All 100 tests across the 8 autopilot test targets pass, so this is a lint-hygiene drift, not a correctness blocker. Suggested fix: `cargo fmt --all` from repo root; verify with `cargo fmt --all -- --check`. Evidence (verbatim):```$ cargo fmt --all -- --check | grep '^Diff'`````Diff in /Users/thiago/Github/master-plan/crates/mp/src/autopilot/list.rs:67`````Diff in /Users/thiago/Github/master-plan/crates/mp/tests/autopilot_session_roundtrip.rs:6`````Diff in /Users/thiago/Github/master-plan/crates/mp/tests/autopilot_session_schema.rs:39`````Diff in /Users/thiago/Github/master-plan/crates/mp/tests/autopilot_session_schema.rs:92`````Diff in /Users/thiago/Github/master-plan/crates/mp/tests/autopilot_session_schema.rs:205`````Diff in /Users/thiago/Github/master-plan/crates/mp/tests/autopilot_session_schema.rs:228````Summary exit code: 1 (rustfmt reports diffs).

findings.description: Each of M207's 8 acceptance_criteria carries the identical placeholder `verification` value `cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_state_file --no-fail-fast`. This is a stale field — the spec-tightening commit `09412e2` (which typed verifications) updated the per-step `tests` field to the correct autopilot-specific targets (`autopilot_session_schema`, `autopilot_session_roundtrip`, …) but the AC-level `verification` field was not propagated. The runner correctly used the step-level `tests` commands when stamping evidence (per-AC evidence is well-formed and matches what I re-ran on a cold build: 20/20, 7/7, 11/11, 13/13, 11/11, 12/12, 11/11, 15/15). The placeholder is misleading for future reviewers/agents who read the AC rather than the step. Suggested fix: per-AC `verification` should mirror the step-level `tests` command, or the AC `verification` field should be dropped if step-level `tests` is canonical. Evidence:```$ mp show milestone 207 --fields 'acceptance_criteria[].verification'```all 8 entries are identical and reference `--test watch_state_file`.
